entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Shri Rajat Gangwar, learned Counsel for the applicants and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. By means of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants, Gaurav Verma, Ashok Kumar Verma, Anita Verma and Sauravh Verma have prayed for quashing of the entire proceedings pending in the case viz State vs. Saurabh and others, Criminal Case No.4003 of 2021, Case Crime No.0311 of 2020 under Section 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961,
Police Station-Mankapur, District-Gonda.
3.

This case was initially referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court vide order dated 07.03.2022 passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court and as per the mediation report dated 03.08.2022, mediation between the parties has failed.

entities.text: Gaurav Verma And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin Secy Home Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned Counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the aforesaid case as they have not committed any offence as alleged in Case Crime No.0311 of 2020 under Section 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
5. Learned AGA has submitted that this petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable as the applicant has got efficacious remedy by filing discharge application.
6. While entertaining this application, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, vide order dated 07.03.2022 has granted interim protection.

7. Taking into consideration the fact that the applicants are having an equally efficacious remedy to file discharge application before the competent Court, without entering into the merits of the issue,
the applicants are permitted to file a discharge application before the trial Court through counsel taking all pleas and grounds, which are available to them, enclosing therewith the relevant documents/evidence, which are necessary for disposal of the discharge application, within a period of three weeks from today and if such application is filed by the applicants before the trial Court within the aforesaid stipulated time, the trial Court shall consider and decide the said application strictly in accordance with law, by speaking and reasoned order and by affording an opportunity of hearing to the concerned parties, expeditiously, say within a period of two weeks thereafter.
8.
The application is, accordingly, disposed of.
